facts.value: ASU requires you to send official transcripts from each high school, college, university or technical school you previously attended.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: High school transcripts must show GPA and date of graduation.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: Transcripts sent via email may be accepted if sent directly from an authorized school official at the issuing institution, or from a third-party verified source, to ASU at transcripts@asu.edu.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: You may also use services such as Parchment, eSCRIP or National Clearinghouse to send electronic transcripts. Choose Arizona State University on the request form to make a request for your institution to send us your official transcripts.
